UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
CONFLICT: Someone else changed this item. Reload and try again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This operation was already sent with different data. Reload and try again.
LAST_OWNER: The organization needs at least one owner.
ROLE_IN_USE: This role is still assigned to members. Remove the assignments before deleting it.
ESCALATION_FORBIDDEN: You can't grant permissions you don't have.
EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email. Sign in with the invited account.
INVITATION_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
INVITATION_ALREADY_USED: This invitation has already been used.
INVALID_UNIT_PARENT: This unit can't be placed inside the chosen unit.
SUBTREE_TOO_LARGE: This unit has too many subunits to move at once.
UNKNOWN_PERMISSION: One of the chosen permissions doesn't exist.
SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You can't approve your own request.
MEMBERSHIP_EXISTS: This person is already a member.
IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: This operation is still being processed. Wait a moment.
UNKNOWN_APPROVAL_ACTION: This kind of approval does not exist.
APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED: This action does not need approval.
NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
INVALID_RESPONSE: We received an unexpected response. Try again in a moment.
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we depend on is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE: This feature is not available right now.
WORKFLOW_NOT_STARTABLE: This workflow cannot be started manually.
SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_TOO_SHORT: The schedule runs too often. Choose a longer interval.
FEATURE_DISABLED: This feature is turned off right now.
EVAL_REQUIRED: Run an evaluation that passes before activating this version.
EVAL_DATASET_MISSING: This agent has no evaluation set yet.
CUSTOM_LIMIT_REACHED: The plan's limit was reached. Delete an item or talk to whoever manages the plan.
BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The organization's AI budget ran out. Contact an administrator.
